works.author: Azmir Sheikh
works.comment: AI 销售助手仪表盘 Reachly 的 Pipeline Command Center：顶部漏斗把 1,280 条线索从联系、互动一路收到 118 次回复、46 场会议，左侧 Meetings goal 72%、$142.5K 配 46 of 64，右侧 Rae automation 把跟进、LinkedIn 邀约、回复处理排成一张时间表；销售漏斗用“数字漏斗 + AI 今日待办”让管理者一眼看到钱在哪一步。
works.comment_en: Reachly's AI sales agent dashboard, the Pipeline Command Center: one funnel runs 1,280 researched leads down to 940 contacted, 312 engaged, 118 replies and 46 meetings, with a 72% meetings goal ($142.5K, 46 of 64) on the left and Rae's automation queue — follow-ups, LinkedIn invites, reply handling — timetabled on the right; a sales funnel reads as numbers plus what the AI does today, so a manager sees exactly where the money sits.
works.title: AI Sales Agent Dashboard UXUI Design

works.author: Yuvrajsinh Zala
works.comment: 电商分析仪表盘 PULSE：黑底配亮橙，Total revenue $1,547,254 配 ▼21% 与上一周期对比，左侧 Conversion 3.54%（每 100 次访问 3.5 单）与 Orders 18,251 两张小卡片垫底，下方 Revenue trend 用实线与虚线对照本期与上期；深色仪表盘用“一块亮色总收入 + 两张小指标卡”把涨跌讲得不吓人。
works.comment_en: PULSE e-commerce analytics dashboard: black with a hot-orange revenue card — $1,547,254 total revenue, down 21% on the previous period — flanked by two small cards, Conversion 3.54% (3.5 orders per 100 sessions) and Orders 18,251, above a revenue trend chart drawing this period solid against last period dashed; a dark dashboard stays calm by leading with one bright total and two small metrics.
works.title: PULSE — Analytics Dashboard Overview

works.author: Ibrahim Khalil
works.comment: 移动端分析看板 octave：两部手机并排，左屏 Key findings 写着 52 个账号 30 天内转入高风险、41 个高风险账号 90 天内续约、涉及 $5.2M ARR，右屏 Renewal timeline 用气泡图按 Healthy、Watch、At risk 三档排开未来 90 天；客户健康度用“结论先行、气泡图随后”讲清哪些账号要先救。
works.comment_en: Mobile analytics dashboards for Octave: two phones side by side — the left leads with Key findings, 52 accounts moved to at-risk in 30 days and 41 at-risk accounts renewing within 90 days worth $5.2M ARR, while the right plots a 90-day renewal timeline as a bubble chart split across Healthy, Watch and At risk; account health reads as conclusions first, bubbles second, so you know which accounts to save first.
works.title: Mobile Analytics Dashboards

works.author: SM Rubel ✦
works.comment: AI 数字代理商官网 Daydream：灰底大标题“Build Intelligent Digital Products That Scale Faster.”，TrustedBy 4.5 分与 10,000+ Trusted Customers 背书，右半边一台立体渲染的复古硬件设备撑满画面；技术代理商用“一句宣言 + 一台硬核设备”把抽象的 AI 能力讲得看得见摸得着。
works.comment_en: Daydream AI agency site: a grey hero under "Build Intelligent Digital Products That Scale Faster.", backed by a 4.5 TrustedBy score and 10,000+ trusted customers, with a chunky 3D render of retro hardware filling the right half; an AI agency makes abstract capability tangible with one declaration plus one solid object.
works.title: Digital Agency Website Design – AI & Technology Landing Page

works.author: NexUX Product for Nexux Lab
works.comment: 植物养护 App：三屏分别是 Monstera Deliciosa 健康度 96%（+4%）配 350 ml 晨间浇水与 Water Now 按钮，右屏 Plant Health 94%（+6%）配周六到周五的生长曲线与 +2.6 cm 本周生长；养花这件慢事用“一个健康度数字 + 一条生长曲线”讲得有成就感。
works.comment_en: Plant care app in three phones: Monstera Deliciosa at 96% health (+4% vs yesterday) with a 350 ml morning routine and a Water Now button, and Plant Health 94% (+6% vs last week) beside a Saturday-to-Friday growth curve showing +2.6 cm this week; slow gardening gains a sense of progress from one health score plus one growth line.
works.title: Plant Care & Gardening Mobile App

works.author: Mohammad Reza Farahzad for Orizon
works.comment: 餐厅数字菜单 App MenuVA（平板版）：四芝士披萨大图配 AED 59.99，Orégano 开场页写着“YOUR TABLE IS READY”，中间 Breakfast、Kebab、Sea Food、Pizza 分类圆标，右侧菜品网格标着 Truffle Mushroom Pizza AED 64.99、Classic Pepperoni AED 52.99；点餐界面用“大图勾食欲、分类圆标分流、价格直接标在图上”三步把人留住。
works.comment_en: MenuVA digital restaurant menu app, tablet edition: a Four Cheese Pizza hero at AED 59.99, an Orégano opener reading "YOUR TABLE IS READY", round category chips for Breakfast, Kebab, Sea Food and Pizza, and a dish grid pricing Truffle Mushroom Pizza at AED 64.99 and Classic Pepperoni at AED 52.99; a menu holds attention in three moves — big photo for appetite, round chips to navigate, price right on the photo.
works.title: 🍕Digital Restaurant Menu App - MenuVA

works.author: Visumind Creative
works.comment: 教练服务官网 Stratix：蓝色主视觉“BUILD A SCALABLE, SELF-RUNNING BUSINESS SYSTEM.”配西装男士，中间三张荧光绿卡片点出 The Overwork Trap、Team Dependency、No Clear Roadmap 三个业务瓶颈，下方 $60M+、5,000+、4.9/5 三组数字背书；咨询类落地页用“痛点三张卡先行、数字背书随后”把转化路径铺直。
works.comment_en: Stratix coaching website: a blue hero — "BUILD A SCALABLE, SELF-RUNNING BUSINESS SYSTEM." beside a suited coach — opens into three lime cards naming the bottlenecks (The Overwork Trap, Team Dependency, No Clear Roadmap), then closes with $60M+, 5,000+ and 4.9/5 as proof; a consulting landing page paves its conversion path with three pain cards first and proof numbers second.
works.title: Stratix — Conversion-Focused Coaching Website
